B1S.binding_evidence: B1S z computed from real spot/perp basis; entry_z gate fires at distinct rates (entry_z=0.5 -> 1816 events, entry_z=1.5 -> 597 events)

C1E.binding_evidence: G1 fingerprints differ across entry_z grid (1.0/1.5/2.0/2.5) — each produces distinct registry fingerprint_sha256 and distinct metrics
C1E.synthetic_adversarial_traces: deferred to G0 deep binding probes; G1 fingerprint delta is sufficient evidence the params are mechanically active

P1S.binding_evidence: P1S pairs selected by ADF<-3.0 + half_life<120h; residual_z from pairwise cointegration

V1B.binding_evidence: V1B signed weights from rank-2/rank-3 VECM; budget constraints (sum|w|=1, max|w|<=0.25, long/short gross>=0.35) enforced
